groups.name: The one you were warned about

villager.lore: They get up, they work, they go home, and they will absolutely tell someone what they saw you do.

merchant.where: Market stalls and the open road
merchant.lore: Everything has a price. If a merchant runs from you, the price went up.

knight.lore: Sworn to the Crown. Calls for friends the moment a sword comes out, and the friends come.

adventurer.lore: Someone in the same line of work as you, doing it less well. Will gladly help with a wolf.

king.lore: Rules by the laws the god cannot break. Looks tired up close.

elf.lore: Some of them remember the last hero. They would rather not discuss it.

elf_guard.lore: Moves through a forest the way water moves through a hand.

elf_royal.lore: Older than the kingdom next door, and politely certain it will outlast it.

beastkin.lore: Fast, proud and quick to laugh. A promise made to a beastkin chief is a promise made to all of them.

mermaid.lore: The deep water belongs to them. They watch ships the way you watch weather.

deer.lore: Bolts at a footstep. The whole herd goes when one of them does.

boar.lore: Leaves you alone until you give it a reason. Then it does not stop.

crab.lore: Small, sideways and deeply offended by your presence.

bat.lore: Harmless. Bursts past your face exactly when you were already nervous.

fish.lore: Small silver schools that scatter when your shadow crosses them.

slime.lore: Not clever. Not fast. There is, however, always one more.

goblin.where: Hills, woods and caves, after dark
goblin.lore: Brave in a crowd. Catch one alone or wound it badly and it will run for its friends.

wolf.lore: They come in numbers and spread out around you. Hurt one, and the rest will not forget.

bandit.lore: Not evil, exactly. Just done paying for things. Will cut and run when the fight turns.

skeleton.where: Caves, ruins, and open ground at night
skeleton.lore: A dead archer who never got the news. Keeps its distance, keeps its aim.

spider.lore: Climbs anything. Waits in the dark until you are close enough to leap at.

orc.lore: A straight line between it and you, and nothing good in the way of it.

troll.lore: Its wounds close while you watch. Do not stop hitting it to catch your breath.

wraith.lore: Rock is no obstacle to something that has forgotten how to be solid.

golem.lore: A law given a body. It does not get tired and it does not take bribes.

bounty_hunter.lore: Your name is on a paper in its pocket. It will find you anywhere, and it will not be talked out of it.

imp.where: The Demon Wastes and on raids
imp.lore: Darts in, bites, and is gone before you have turned around. Comes back for more.

demon_knight.lore: Armour with an old grudge inside it.

demon_lord.lore: The First Law keeps every blade from him. Almost every blade.

echo.where: Scattered across the world, one to a land
echo.lore: Eleven of them, each cut by a different hand in a language nobody here has ever spoken. You can read every one.

cairn.where: The ruins in the far south
cairn.lore: Someone stacked these stones carefully, a long time ago, and left a note.

law_stone.where: The feet of the Crystal Spires
law_stone.lore: The rules of the world, written where anyone could read them, if they got this far.

mermaid_queen.where: A palace under the southwestern sea
mermaid_queen.lore: She has been listening to the sea for a very long time. She has heard about you.

dragon.lore: There is only one. It sleeps on a hoard older than the kingdom, it remembers everyone who woke it, and no blade has ever marked it. It will chase you off its mountain to make sure you understand.
